# anthropic_compliance_settings (Data Source)

Reads the organization's Compliance Settings (`/v1/organizations/compliance_settings`). An organization with a parent organization reads the state inherited from the parent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_compliance_settings" "this" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `compliance_settings`.
- `state` (String) Whether the Compliance API is enabled: `enabled` or `disabled`.
